name: Jubilee
summary: Bankruptcy petition preparation, document automation and case management for legal practices. Size the tier to your real filing volume; sporadic filers do better per case.
best_for: bankruptcy attorneys and legal professionals who want streamlined petition preparation, document automation and case management for filings
skip_if: you don't practice bankruptcy law, or you file so few cases that a general practice-management tool plus manual forms is enough
honest_knock: It's a focused vertical tool — bankruptcy petition preparation and case management — so its whole value is bounded by that practice area; a general legal practice won't get much from it. The case-count tiers are the thing to size correctly: pick 36 vs 300 by your real annual filing volume, and check whether the pay-per-case option is cheaper if you file sporadically. For a bankruptcy practice, the automation and court-form handling are exactly the point.

pricing.plans_source: hand-curated from the vendor's pricing page
pricing.notes: Pay As You Go is $95 per case. The alternative is an annual subscription billed by yearly filing volume. Jubilee 36 is $995/yr (up to 36 filings, 2 users, $34.99/case over) and Jubilee 150 $2,495/yr (up to 150, 3 users, $26.99 over). Jubilee 300 is $3,995/yr (up to 300, 3 users, $17.99 over) and Jubilee 500 $4,995/yr (up to 500, 5 users, $12.99 over). Prices are for annual billing; above 500 filings a year the vendor quotes custom pricing. Every amount, user count and overage rate re-verified 2026-09-22 on www.jubileepro.com/pricing, unchanged since 10 September 2026. The page also carries Free Trial and Start Free Trial buttons without publishing a trial length or terms, and describes the subscription as software access "without bundling filing services" — the Diligence Services line is sold separately.
